schema: K15t entropy bonus lambda=0.5 on Dream-7B (lr=2e-6). 9 cells r=64 x rho in {0.05,0.40,0.90} x n=3 seeds. Cross-family validation of theorem-predicted loss-level intervention.
theorem_cross_family_consistency: The Pre-Equilibrium Saturation Theorem Corollary 2 predicts that the entropy-regularizer asymptote S_inf decreases monotonically in lambda BUT is also bounded above by S_0. For Dream-7B with S_0 = 1.0, even lambda -> infinity cannot reduce trajectory entropy because there is no initial entropy to maintain. K15t works on MDLM (S_0=0.36) but not Dream-7B (S_0=1.0). Cross-family validation supports the theorem.
verdict: NEGATIVE (cross-family confirmation that entropy regularization is BOUNDED by initial S_0). Dream-7B mean_top1 traj 0.999 vs MDLM 0.58 (32% reduction on MDLM). Entropy bonus at lambda=0.5 has 0% mass-reduction on Dream-7B because step0_top1 = 1.0 — no entropy to penalize.
